integrity: The analytic argument proves the infinite claims; a standalone 754-check exact-symbolic and high-precision verifier checks identities and representative data, not originality or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for normalized exponential Taylor polynomials of degrees one through five on one canonical planar harmonic oscillator in exact arithmetic. The explicit stage-chain Runge–Kutta methods realize those polynomials on the oscillator but are not asserted to have general nonlinear order equal to polynomial degree. No general nonlinear or multidimensional phase claims are made. The 2015 Calvo et al. projection/dispersion paper could only be compared at the abstract level, leaving a relevant literature-priority risk.
title: A sharp three-to-one step-size aliasing window for energy-projected Taylor oscillators
